learningGoals: Learn and properly use greeting and parting phrases in daily conversation. 🤝
Recognize vocabulary related to time, waiting, and returning. ⏳
Understand and express emotions connected to people coming and going. 💖
Read dialogue between characters with appropriate emotional expression. 🗣️
Identify the difference between leaving a place and returning to a place. 🚶‍♂️
conversationStarters: How do you feel when a good friend or family member goes away for a few days? 🥺
What special things do we say when someone leaves, and what do we say when they return? 💬
What is the most exciting thing about coming back home after a long day? 🏡
teachingTips: Roleplay greetings and goodbyes using their favorite stuffed animals or action figures. 🧸
Help your child recognize emotion words by asking them to make a happy face or a sad face when reading those words. 🎭
Explain the concept of 'soon' by setting short timers for fun activities so they understand waiting. ⏲️
Encourage your child to read the character's speaking parts with different voices to make reading fun. 🎤
Practice sight words like 'come', 'go', and 'back' by writing them on sticky notes around the house. 📝

funActivities.title: Hello and Goodbye Roleplay 🎭
funActivities.description: Pretend you are going on a trip. Have your child wave and say 'Goodbye, come back soon!'. Then pretend to return and have them say 'Hello, welcome back!'.

funActivities.title: Welcome Home Card 💌
funActivities.description: Create a colorful 'Welcome Back' card using crayons and paper for someone in the family who comes home from work or a trip.

funActivities.title: The Waiting Game 🚦
funActivities.description: Play Red Light, Green Light. Use the word 'Wait' for red light and 'Go' for green light. It helps them practice the vocabulary while moving around safely.
